password.description: Password (login only). Register returns a generated password.

topic.description: With action="help": focus help on an action name, category, or search keyword. Searches across all tools.

username.description: Username (register/login). 3-24 chars: Latin letters, digits, spaces, underscores, hyphens, apostrophes, periods, exclamation marks, single-codepoint emoji. Other scripts and joined emoji are rejected.

action.description: Action name — see description for full list

count.description: Number of results per page (get_version: 1-20, default 5)

deliver_to.description: Craft output destination; for package recipes this is an alias for target. With job_id it redirects that already-queued job's remaining output instead of queuing anything new.

dry_run.description: Quote the selected craft without queuing or spending

id.description: Target: POI ID, system ID, item ID, player ID, etc. (depends on action). For refuel/repair, optionally selects the fuel cell or repair kit item.

items.description: For craft id=pack_package: items to pack as {item_id, quantity}; total unpacked size may not exceed 100.

job_id.description: Queued craft job to act on: alone it cancels and refunds; with deliver_to it redirects that job's remaining output instead

job_ids.description: Queued craft jobs to cancel independently and refund

jobs.description: Bulk craft jobs; package entries carry their own manifest, label, package_id, source, and target

label.description: For craft id=pack_package: player-authored package label

mode.description: For scan: cargo runs a 3-tick cargo scan of a player id instead of an ordinary scan

output_package_label.description: Bundle the whole job's outputs into one new package with this label in the destination on completion (consumes a cargo_container). Needs a Logistics facility; total output must fit one package (size <= 100). The queue response and completion crafting_update return the sealed package's output_package_id, so you never need to poll for it.

package_id.description: For craft id=unpack_package: package instance ID to unpack

package_ids.description: Source the craft's inputs from these packages (raw id or package:<id>). They must sit in the source location and match the recipe inputs times quantity EXACTLY (no shortage/overage, no storage backfill).

preset.description: Craft routing preset; workshop forces hand-crafting (including slower unpack_package)

quantity.description: Amount (depends on action). For remote refuel, omit to transfer the maximum allowed by donor reserve and recipient tank space; fuel-cell and repair-kit use defaults to 1.

ship_id.description: For uninstall_mod: optional owned ship ID. Omit or leave empty for your active ship; stored ships must be parked at your docked station, outside a garage, carrier, tow, or exchange listing.

source.description: Craft input source (package recipes also accept cargo); for pay_bounty, who funds it: self or faction

target.description: Action-specific target. For refuel/repair use a player ID or username at the same real POI, or 'fleet' for a read-only fleet status report. For package recipes: storage, cargo, faction, or faction:<bucket>; defaults to source.

text.description: Text input: search query, comma-separated values, etc.

topic.description: With action="help": focus help on an action name, category, or search keyword. Searches across all tools.

action.description: Action name — see description for full list

all_stations.description: Search every station you have charted instead of one; cheapest first and paged. Cannot be combined with base_id (browse_ships)

bare_hull.description: If true, commission without the default module loadout; false by default (commission_ship and commission_quote)

base_id.description: Station Base ID or station POI ID (commission_status filter or browse_ships location)

can_fly.description: Only ships you could buy and fly now (browse_ships)

crew.description: Fit crew to recruit, or injured crew to treat

fit_crew.description: Fit crew to transfer to an allied ship or faction reserve

fit_marines.description: Fit marines to transfer to an allied ship or faction reserve

fund_from_faction.description: If true, build from your faction's treasury and storage at your own faction's station or an allied station that shares its shipyard (commission_ship; requires manage_treasury)

id.description: Target: ship class, ship ID, listing ID, commission ID, buy order ID, or allied player for personnel treatment/transfer

injured_crew.description: Injured crew to transfer to an allied ship or faction reserve

injured_marines.description: Injured marines to transfer to an allied ship or faction reserve

item_id.description: Item ID to supply to a commission (supply_commission)

marines.description: Fit marines to recruit, or injured marines to treat

modules.description: Planned fit as module type IDs, one per fitted module (fit_preview)

page_size.description: Listings per page with all_stations (browse_ships, default 50, max 100)

price.description: Price in credits (for list_ship_for_sale and place_ship_buy_order)

provide_materials.description: If true, you deliver build materials and required modules yourself (commission_ship, empire stations)

reserve.description: Treat the local faction personnel reserve (treat_personnel; provider=faction, ManageTreasury)

ship_id.description: Stored ship to sell into a buy order (sell_ship_to_order)

source_missing_materials.description: If true, contribute available cargo/storage and pay the yard to source only the deficit (commission_ship and commission_quote, empire stations)

topic.description: With action="help": focus help on an action name, category, or search keyword. Searches across all tools.

action.description: Action name — see description for full list

all.description: For unmute_notifications: true to unmute all channels

content.description: Message text, journal entry, note body, reply content, status, or colors JSON

reply_id.description: For forum_upvote: reply to upvote in the target thread (omit to upvote the thread)

target.description: Channel name (local/system/faction), thread ID, note ID, or reply ID

target_id.description: Player name or ID (or an NPC authority sender_id) for get_chat_history when channel (target) is "private"

title.description: Thread or note title (for create operations)

topic.description: With action="help": focus help on an action name, category, or search keyword. Searches across all tools.

bucket.description: Faction Storage Extension bucket, by its name or id, used as the faction side of a deposit, withdraw, or personal↔faction transfer. For an intra-faction move (source=faction target=faction) it is the SOURCE compartment. Omit for the main store. See bucket names in 'view' target=faction.

credits.description: Credits to gift a player, to donate to an empire, a station:<id> or a pirate:<crew>, or to repay your debt with target="fixer:tab" (action="deposit"). Same as item_id="credits" with quantity.

dest_bucket.description: Destination compartment for an intra-faction move (source=faction target=faction): items go from bucket into dest_bucket. Either empty = main store (covers main↔bucket and bucket↔bucket). Requires manage_treasury.

item_id.description: Item ID, "credits" for credit operations, or a ship instance ID (for carrier loading into your own or a faction-mate's bay, bay unloading by the ship's or carrier's owner, tow-attach with a tow rig, or gifting, including a bay ship while its carrier is at a station). For action="loot"/"jettison": the cargo item ID.

items.description: Bulk deposit/withdraw/jettison: array of {item_id, quantity} objects handled in a single action (one write) instead of one per tick. Items only. Honors target/source like single-item (cargo↔personal, cargo↔faction, personal↔faction transfers, faction compartment moves with source=faction target=faction + bucket/dest_bucket, gifts); not accepted for target="fixer:tab" (invalid_payload). For action=jettison recoverable output goes into one container at a POI after immediate liquid-to-ice conversion. Incomplete batches dissipate; no recoverable output means no container. Mid-flight cargo is lost. Omit item_id/quantity when using this. The response reports per-item success/failure.

message.description: Message with a gift or donation (player, empire, station or pirate target)

module_id.description: Module instance ID to loot from a wreck into cargo (action="loot").

source.description: For transfers: "cargo" (default), "storage" (personal→faction), or "faction" (faction→personal, or faction→faction compartment move with target=faction)

station_id.description: Station Base ID or station POI ID to view storage at without docking (action="view" only)

target.description: "self" (default), "faction", "faction:TAG", an empire alias, "pirate:<crew>" (credit wire), "carrier:<pilot name>" (load your ship into a faction-mate's carrier bay), a player name, or "station:<base-or-POI-ID>" for optional unpaid item or credit donations while docked at that managed NPC empire station or pirate stronghold. Station donations support cargo or personal storage and bulk items; no packages/quest items; ships only to a pirate stronghold. Gifts to empires, stations and pirate crews return a goodwill field. fixer:tab repays debt with positive wallet credits at an empire mission station; no bulk entries.

wreck_id.description: Wreck ID to loot (action="loot"). Omit to loot the wreck you're towing.

amount.description: Credits to prepay toward faction tax (for prepay_tax)

id.description: Target: faction ID, player ID, role ID, room ID, etc.

limit.description: Max results per page (for info action member list, default 50 max 100)

offset.description: Pagination offset (for info action member list)

text.description: Text: faction name, war reason, peace terms, etc.

x.description: Target x coordinate in AU for move_mobile_base

y.description: Target y coordinate in AU for move_mobile_base

company_store.description: view_market: show ONLY your faction's private Company Store listings (members-only). Requires faction membership.

item_id.description: Item ID for orders or market queries

search.description: view_orders: substring search on item names

station_id.description: Station Base ID or station POI ID to view orders at without docking (view_orders only)

class.description: Ships only: filter by ship role (Miner, Fighter, Hauler, etc.)

commissionable.description: Ships only: filter to ships this player can commission at this shipyard (requires auth + docked)

empire.description: Ships only: filter by empire (solarian, voidborn, crimson_fleet, nebula_collective, outer_rim)

id.description: Look up a specific entry by ID

search.description: Text search across names, descriptions, class, empire, and tier

session_id.description: Session ID from login/register (optional for catalog)

garage.description: For board: stow your current ship in the faction ship garage instead of parking it at the station

id.description: Player name or ID (for invite/kick, or the carrier for board)

topic.description: With action="help": focus help on an action name, category, or search keyword. Searches across all tools.

amount.description: Debt payment amount; omit to pay the full balance

base_reward.description: Flat carrier reward paid on delivery; required to post (you set the price — no automatic rate)

destination_base_id.description: Different destination station for quote/post, as a base ID or station POI ID; another station in the same system is valid

filter_destination.description: List: only runs bound for this destination station, by either its Base ID or station POI ID

filter_origin.description: List_all: only runs posted at this origin station, by either its Base ID or station POI ID

filter_service_level.description: List: only runs of this service tier

filter_shipper.description: List: only runs posted by this shipper (player username, faction name/tag, or station name)

include_ineligible.description: List/list_all: also show contracts the eligible_as carrier cannot accept now, each with eligible=false and ineligible_reason

max_total_cost.description: Optional post guard against quote changes

package_id.description: Sealed package ID (bare ID or the package:<id> cargo item): the freight to ship for quote/post, or the box you are holding for get/track/deliver/return

recipient_id.description: Recipient player, faction, or station ID; a station takes its base ID or station POI ID

shipment_id.description: Freight contract ID; get/track/deliver/return also accept a package ID here

shipper.description: Posting actor: caller or caller's current faction

source_bucket_id.description: Faction Storage Extension bucket ID when source=faction

speed_bonus.description: Optional extra for fast delivery, decaying to zero at the deadline
